data.narrative:
Sift Stack is a Series B-stage AI & Software company that has raised $67M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage private peers (Scale AI at $29.0B, Physical Intelligence at $5.6B, and Black Forest Labs at $3.2B), supplemented by a broader set of 9 private frontier-tech comparables and 1 public reference (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $67M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implying a valuation of $127M. Peer-Median derives the median valuation across the 3 direct comparables, yielding $5.6B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $29.0B. The dispersion reflects genuine heterogeneity in the AI & Software sector at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $108M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.9B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Sift Stack's positioning relative to the peer set. Stage-Progression implies near-term near-term runway valuation, while Peer-Median anchors to demonstrated market values of functionally comparable, contemporaneous stage companies. Key uncertainties include revenue growth trajectory, competitive differentiation within the AI software stack, and capital efficiency relative to peer burn profiles.
